components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The hot control. Signal Orange fill, used for the main action in a viewport.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-canvas); padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-soft); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -12px var(--color-accent); } .ds-btn-primary:hover svg { transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The quiet action. Transparent pill with a strong hairline, turning orange on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-secondary">Get in touch <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 17 17 7M17 7H9M17 7v8"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong); border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: var(--color-accent); border-color: var(--color-accent); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover svg { transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Inset field on a tile. Focus is a Signal Orange border, not the global ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-field span { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-input { display: block; width: 16rem; margin-top: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-elevated) 60%, transparent); color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-faint); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--color-line-strong); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-accent); outline: none; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Quiet mono tag for a tool or skill on a tile.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-elevated) 60%, transparent); color: var(--color-muted); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }

components.name: Live Status
components.description: Featured status pill. Orange at 12% strength, orange text, no border.
components.css: .ds-chip-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 12%, transparent); color: var(--color-accent); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Tile
components.description: Content container. Flat at rest, rises and glows orange on hover.
components.html:
Automation

Migration & Release Strategy

Advising teams through platform migrations and release cutovers.
components.css: .ds-tile { max-width: 28rem; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-tile); background: var(--color-surface); transition: transform 0.3s, border-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-tile-kicker { margin: 0; color: var(--color-accent); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tile h3 { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-tile p:last-child { margin: 12px 0 0; color: var(--color-muted); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; } .ds-tile:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 50%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -32px var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Section links. The current one is Readout White with a Signal Orange tick.
components.html: ExperienceProjectsAboutContact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav a.is-current { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav a.is-current::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; bottom: 4px; height: 1px; background: var(--color-accent); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Monogram
components.description: 32px Signal Orange mark with the initials, used at the start of the nav.
components.css: .ds-mark { display: grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; place-items: center; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-canvas); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a dark instrument panel for a person, not a product. Console Black is the chassis. Inter carries the name, the roles, and the paragraphs a hiring manager actually reads. JetBrains Mono is the readout: dates, tags, and handles. Signal Orange is the one live indicator. It marks the title, the primary action, the active section, and the labels that say where you are.

The mood is technical but human. Restraint keeps the chrome thin, and the orange plus the personal record keep the page from turning into a dashboard. Tiles sit flat on the chassis until a pointer arrives; then they rise. Motion is short, eased, and removed when the visitor asks for less of it.

The system refuses generic startup landing pages: gradient headlines, purple-blue glows, and marketing chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Dark chassis by default, with a light reassignment of the same tokens
Mono for labels, sans for reading
Pills for actions, 1.25rem tiles for content
Flat at rest, lifted on hover
Focus is always a 2px Signal Orange ring

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange is the only chromatic color. It marks the live title, the primary action, active navigation, and selection. It does not fill large surfaces. The hero wash is a 16% mix that fades out, not a second background.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Text tokens are chosen to clear 4.5:1 against Console Black and Console Surface. Readout Faint is part of that floor because mono labels are small.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is for dates, meta, tags, and handles. Names, headings, and paragraphs stay in Inter.

rules.name: The Single Chassis Rule
rules.body: New blocks join the 72rem column. They do not introduce a second max width, a full-bleed marketing band, or a sidebar.

rules.name: The Hover Lift Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow and a rise appear only as a hover response, and only on controls and tiles that already use them.

rules.name: The Pill and Tile Rule
rules.body: If it is an action or a status, it is a pill. If it holds a paragraph, it is a tile. Do not mix those jobs.

dos: Do keep Signal Orange as the only chromatic color, and keep it off large fills.
Do leave dark as the default. Light mode reassigns the same tokens; it does not introduce a second palette.
Do use Inter for reading and JetBrains Mono for labels.
Do lift primary buttons and tiles on hover, and leave them flat at rest.
Do draw focus as a 2px Signal Orange outline, 3px outside the control, with a 4px corner.
Do gate entrance motion, smooth scrolling, and the availability pulse behind a reduced-motion preference.
donts: Don't use gradient headlines, purple-blue glows, or marketing chrome.
Don't add a second accent, a gradient text treatment, or a resting drop shadow on tiles.
Don't set paragraphs or the person's name in JetBrains Mono.
Don't invent a new resting shadow. The hover shadows already on buttons and tiles are the whole vocabulary.
Don't repeat the hero grid behind later sections.
